title: My English class
instructions: Yusuf İngilizce dersini anlatıyor. Gün, saat ve öğretmene dikkat et.

script.speaker: s
script.text: I have English on Mondays and Thursdays.

script.speaker: s
script.text: The class starts at ten o'clock.

script.speaker: s
script.text: My teacher is from Canada. Her name is Mrs White.

script.speaker: s
script.text: We sing songs and play games. It is my favourite class.
